thread:
Maya: FYI found silent v2->v1 routing for tenant-271 during a model OOM window. Console showed no deprecation or any visible hint. :grimacing:
Diego: Ugh. How did we not surface that? Is this the same class as previous fallback discussions or something new?
routemgr-bot: Event: implicit_route_switch{tenant="tenant-271", reason="capacity"} logged x43 in 8m.
Maya: Logs show header `x-api-version: 2` on incoming requests but `routed_version: 1` downstream. Fallback reason=capacity. Billing implications + contract mismatch.
Priya: Could be the autoscaler bouncing V2 pools during backlog. We need a low-verbosity signal in console per-route that doesn't look like a deprecation banner.
Diego: Agreed. Idea: a small inline "version instability" pill on each route row with three states: probe (dot+tooltip), elevated (count), broken (actionable).
Casey: From telemetry side: propose a derived metric `version_divergence_rate` = rate(implicit_route_switch[5m]) + 0.5*rate(header_version_mismatch[5m]). We'll index by tenant+route+model_hash.
Priya: Cardinality is a concern. For high-card tenants sample routes; otherwise roll-up to `route=__other__`. Also keep a tenant-level aggregate to power console badges.
Maya: For alerting, let's start with a probe rule (no page) that fires when tenant-level divergence > 8 in 10m AND > 2x the 7d median. Example pseudo-PromQL: `sum by (tenant) (increase(implicit_route_switch[10m])) > 8 and increase(implicit_route_switch[10m]) > 2 * median_over_time(increase(implicit_route_switch[10m])[7d:1m])`
Diego: Might want to combine header mismatches too so transient L7 proxies don't wake it. e.g. `(implicit_route_switch>8 && header_mismatch>4)`
Casey: We'll add a Graf panel mock: top row shows tenant sparkline (last 24h), second row per-route table with `instability_score`, `recent_fallbacks`, `last_trace`. Drill-down opens a trace view pre-filtered.
Priya: UX note: Badge colors -> gray (ok), amber (probe, tooltip explains), orange (investigate, shows counts), red (sustained >30m). Clicking badge shows action links: "pin to v2", "request burst", "open support ticket (prefill)".
Maya: Also add an audit event whenever we silently downgrade at >5 reqs/min from same tenant: `audit.event: silent_downgrade` with sample of requests. CS likes this for triage.
Diego: How about making the console banner optional per-org? Some customers prefer to be yelled at; others hate noise. Default: show badge, not a global banner.
Casey: Implementation plan: 1) emit `implicit_route_switch` and `header_version_mismatch` as stable metrics 2) compute `version_divergence_rate` derived metric at scraper 3) add dashboard panels and badge API 4) probe alert rule 5) 72h data collection and threshold tuning 6) enable per-tenant auto-actions (pin/burst) behind a feature flag.
Priya: For the Prom rules I'll draft two: a tenant-level probe rule and a route-level quieter rule. Will include a `for: 5m` to reduce flapping.
Maya: Ops ask: include remediation hints in alert payload: links to the autoscaler events, last 5 deploys, and a quick command to temporarily pin: `redwood admin pin-route --tenant tenant-271 --route /chat --version v2 --duration 30m`
Diego: Love the prescriptive runbooks. Also add a small telemetry dimension for `downgrade_initiator` (autoscaler|quota|manual) so we can separate causes later.
Casey: I'll prototype the badge svg + tooltip copy. Keeping it compact: `Version instability: 12 fallbacks in 10m` and a link to dive.
Priya: Let's avoid automatic pinning by default; only suggest. Feature flag approach sounds good.
Maya: Can someone own the quick experiment? I can shepherd and validate weekend traffic.
Diego: I'll own the alert rules + Graf panel. Casey you own metrics. Priya owns the UX mock and console wiring.
routemgr-bot: Note: metric `version_divergence_rate` added to catalog (pending).
Maya: Thanks folks. Sync tomorrow 11am to review the first 24h of signals.
